exposure: timing of IUCD insertion (postpartum vs interval)
outcome: incidence of dislocated IUCD requiring operative interventions
investigations needed to localise the IUCD
cohort: 20 patients who underwent operative interventions for retrieval of a dislocated IUCD
finding: Minimally invasive approach proved to be the preferred diagnostic and the therapeutic modality for the dislocated IUCD.
